headline: Ahrefs: AI Overviews now appear on 83% of US branded searches — and the brand rarely owns the first position | Ahrefs：83% 的美国品牌词搜索出现 AI Overviews，品牌官网很少占据第一位

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: AI Overviews on 82.9% of US desktop branded SERPs (Sep 29), up from 61% in July; in 76% of cases the AIO sits at position 1 above the brand | 9/29 美国桌面端 82.9% 的品牌词 SERP 有 AIO（7 月为 61%），76% 的情况下 AIO 排在品牌官网之上
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: 品牌词是最后一块“安全流量”。AIO 占据第一位并引用维基百科（71.9%）、YouTube、LinkedIn 等第三方来描述你的品牌，意味着品牌叙事的控制权在外移，品牌词 CTR 需要单独监控。
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence: dataset: 232.8M US desktop SERPs Jul–Sep 2026 (92.5M branded) + 100 Interbrand brand queries × 14 weekly checks (Ahrefs)
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Ahrefs (Ryan Law with data scientist Xibeijia Guan) analysed 232.8M US desktop Google results from July to September 2026 (92.5M branded, 140.2M non-branded keywords). AIO presence on branded SERPs rose month over month from 61.3% to 65.1% to 73.3%, reaching 82.91% on Sep 29, versus 73.5%→78.3% for non-branded. In a panel of 100 Interbrand brand names, AIOs went from 5/98 (Jul 1) to 63/100 (Sep 30), 76.2% of them at position 1. Most-cited external sources: Wikipedia 71.9%, YouTube 38.6%, LinkedIn 22.8%; only 2 of 58 answers mentioned competitors. No click or CTR impact is measured; US desktop only; Google changes AIO triggers often.
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: 在 GSC 里为品牌词建单独的正则筛选，按周看 CTR 与点击；用 AIO 对你品牌词的回答核对维基百科、LinkedIn、YouTube 上的品牌信息是否过时或错误。

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Kevin Indig (2,500-domain visibility index): SaaS lost a third of its Google visibility in a year; Realtor.com and Amazon at record lows | Kevin Indig（2500 域名可见度指数）：SaaS 一年丢掉三分之一 Google 可见度，Realtor.com 与 Amazon 创新低
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 这是跨行业的面板数据而非个案：SaaS 的下滑与 Lily Ray 观察到的 listicle/对比页模式一致，说明 B2B 软件站的内容型流量正在结构性收缩。
AI Search / GEO.evidence: panel data (paywalled): Growth Memo Growth Intelligence Brief #25, Oct 2, 2026
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: Kevin Indig says he has tracked 2,500+ domains' search visibility, categorised by industry, and publishes the analysis fortnightly to paid Growth Memo subscribers. The public summary of GIB #25 states SaaS lost a third of its Google visibility in a year, Realtor.com and Amazon hit record lows, Homes.com a record high, X jumped 33% and Reddit sits at its March low. The underlying figures, baseline dates and methodology are behind the paywall and could not be verified here; treat the magnitude as the author's claim.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: SaaS 站点：按内容类型（listicle、对比页、how-to、产品页）拆分近 12 个月自然点击趋势，确认下滑集中在哪类；对纯获客型 listicle 评估合并或下线。

sources.name: @Kevin_Indig
sources.excerpt: Many don't know this, but I've been tracking a set of +2,500 domains and their Search Visibility. I have categorized and classified those domains to track how industries change and who wins. Every 2 weeks, I share this and much more data with premium Growth Memo subscribers in the Growth Intelligence Brief (GIB). The 5 strongest winners from today's issue: 1. IRS (Government) +107.0%. The Google PDF outage caused a previous dip. The IRS returned to 57 visibility points, at the cost of H&R Block (-19.5%), Intuit (-15.6%) and TaxAct (-25.5%). The Small Business Administration and the Department of Education haven’t recovered. 2. Common Sense Media (Content Platform) +43.1%. A shaker in GIB…

Unconfirmed Watchlist.what_happened: Kevin Indig: AI Mode answers a clear buying-intent query with zero product cards, links or citations | Kevin Indig：AI Mode 对明确购买意图的查询给出零商品卡、零链接、零引用的回答
Unconfirmed Watchlist.why_it_matters: 如果 AI Mode 在商业查询上不展示任何出口，电商的“被引用”策略也会失效；需要确认这是测试、bug 还是常态。
Unconfirmed Watchlist.evidence_detail: A single observation posted on X: a query with clear buying intent returned an AI Mode answer with no product cards, no links and no citations. No query, market or reproduction count is given, so this cannot be distinguished from a test or a rendering bug; it is logged because AI Mode's treatment of commercial queries is the variable ecommerce teams most need to track.
Unconfirmed Watchlist.what_to_do: 监控：每周用 10 个高购买意图查询在 AI Mode 里截图记录是否出现商品卡/链接/引用，建立基线；暂不据此调整策略。

sources.name: @Kevin_Indig
sources.excerpt: This stuns me: clear buying intent and 0 product cards or even links in AI Mode. Not even citations / sources. What is going on?. This stuns me: clear buying intent and 0 product cards or even links in AI Mode. Not even citations / sources. What is going on?
sources.author: @Kevin_Indig
